text:
Amy: Quick heads-up — planning coordinated version bumps for tomorrow's cut: api 0.14.0, runtime 0.9.3, console 1.2.0, sdk-js 0.14.0. Target cutoff Thu 2026-03-19 18:00 UTC. Flag blockers.

Raj: @Amy any consumer-visible API changes? migration notes?

Amy: API surface is stable. Runtime introduces a KV cache layout bump (kv_layout v2). We'll add a compatibility shim in sdk-js to avoid breaking customers. PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/789 https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/456

Diego: Runtime PR changes serialized keys and ordering. Need migration for persisted caches and on-disk format version bump. Can we gate with a feature flag so older nodes don't crash? @Sophia

Sophia: Yes. Ops plan: canary rollout with flag disabled by default, enable per-cluster. Schedule: Thu 08:00 UTC canary -> smoke -> 10% -> 50% -> full. Dedicated nodes need rolling restart window; I've booked maintenance 2026-03-19 09:30-10:30 PT. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/release-ops

Diego: I'll add a small migration utility. Sketch:
```
# migrate cache to layout v2
python tools/migrate_cache.py --src /var/lib/redwood/cache_v1 --dst /var/lib/redwood/cache_v2
systemctl restart redwood-runtime.service
```
Will open PR for the util and a follow-up to wire it into canary prep.

Amy: Two asks before cutoff: 1) SDK teams add runtime compatibility matrix in README. 2) Console verify feature flags don't 500 if telemetry fields missing.

Raj: I'll add the README table in sdk-js PR #456 and include shim notes. Ping for CR.

CI-bot: runtime PR #789 — integration failing (test_integration_cache.py timeout). Logs: https://ci.redwood/build/789/logs

Diego: Acknowledged, increasing test timeout and improving mocks, pushing fix.

CI-bot: sdk-js PR #456 — all checks passed — merge queued.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: 2026-03-19 08:15 UTC -> canary-3.

Amy: Final ask: post +1s by Thu 16:00 UTC. If green, we'll cut tags and open release PRs. Thanks :rocket:

Raj: +1

Diego: +1

Sophia: +1
